notes: cics-crucible pseudo-conversational / pc-aid-menu (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): HANDLE AID menu with PF-key labels that fall through, an unhandled key, CLEAR, XCTL versus RETURN TRANSID. Each scenario is one task; the crucible's multi-turn flows are restated as one scenario per leg, each carrying the COMMAREA the previous leg returned. The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: a new session, the welcome menu

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR is tested before the RECEIVE: the menu is redrawn with CLEARED

scenarios.name: pf3-exit
scenarios.why: PF3: HANDLE AID label MENU-EXIT, the menu ends

scenarios.name: pf5-refresh
scenarios.why: PF5: the label MENU-REFRESH falls through into SHOW-MENU

scenarios.name: pf9-not-active
scenarios.why: PF9 has no label: the RECEIVE succeeds and KEY NOT ACTIVE is shown

scenarios.name: option-1-xctl
scenarios.why: option 1: XCTL to PCDETL with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: option-2-next-transid
scenarios.why: option 2: SEND TEXT then RETURN TRANSID(PC12) with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: invalid-option
scenarios.why: option 9: WHEN OTHER redisplays the menu with INVALID OPTION
